rows.item: Secondary sources disagree on whether online sports betting is authorised in Mexico. Some say it is legal under a SEGOB permit holder; others say online operation needs a separate DGJS authorisation; one says online gambling is 'legal' with ~30 licensed operators (S14). The official 1947 law text reviewed (S05) contains no online provision in the articles read.
rows.why: No official SEGOB statement was retrieved. No operator counts or tax rates were used.

rows.item: The Cámara ficha lists 'Sin reforma' (no amending decrees). Secondary sources cite a regulation reform of 16 Nov 2023 and a law reform announced in Sep 2026.
rows.why: Could not confirm either reform from an official source. Not used.

rows.item: The NFL gambling policy text and the Nov 2025 prop-bet memo were not retrieved from an official source. Quotes come from ESPN, Philadelphia Inquirer and MLive.
rows.why: Official NFL gambling-policy and November 2025 prop-memo text was not retrieved. S04 is only an official search starting point; the cited quotations/reporting remain secondary and unverified.

rows.item: The 2017 NFL Personnel (Injury) Report Policy cited by secondary sources was not retrieved. Definitions (Out / Doubtful / Questionable) and the Wed-Fri schedule come from secondary sources.
rows.why: Definitions match the secondary sources but are not confirmed from the primary policy.

rows.item: 46 active players per game and 90-minute inactive deadline come from secondary sources only.
rows.why: Not confirmed from the 2026 NFL Rulebook or the CBA.

rows.item: Kickoff times for games other than the 2026 Week 10 schedule page sections read come from the time headers on the injury report page (NFL.com).
rows.why: Both pages are NFL.com; the schedule page was only partly read. Times are ET as published.

rows.item: No local-time conversion is published by this site; NFL injury/game times remain labelled as source-published ET. No UTC offset is asserted.
rows.why: A local-time preference and conversion are not needed for the current tables and have not been added.

rows.item: Repo has no README content, no source code, no .gitignore, and no CI workflow.
rows.why: Recorded for review; see repo review R-02, R-03.

The 160 injury rows were transcribed by hand from the NFL.com report text fetched on 2026-11-14 (no automated parser). Totals (66 Out, 10 Doubtful, 84 Questionable) are computed from the file, not typed.
rows.why: Manual transcription can contain typos. Each row links to its player page so it can be checked one by one.

rows.item: The NFL Support odds-widget FAQ lists FanDuel, Caesars, and DraftKings; the 2026 sportsbook-partnership announcement names DraftKings, FanDuel, and Fanatics Betting and Gaming.
rows.why: Both pages are official but may describe different widgets, partners, or periods. Do not treat the lists as interchangeable or as an odds API, price history, or data licence.
